notes: After the T3 Concerto run bounced off Ping, the Runner made no further runs and clicked for credits on T4-T8, banking 28 credits with a full grip. Meanwhile the Corp advanced Stoke the Embers (T5-T6) and Witch Hunt (T7-T9) in Server 2, which was guarded only by Ping, and was never contested.

R&D had no ice until T5 while the Runner ran it 11 times, stealing Sericulture Expansion and Hybrid Release (T1, then Hybrid Release again T8), and the Corp iced remotes and HQ first. Project Yagi-Uda sat unadvanced in Server 2 from T2 to T7 and was stolen once the Corp was too broke (0 credits T8) to rez the inner ice. The late game was fine, scoring Fujii behind Ivik.

After stealing Divested Trust T4, the Runner clicked for credits nearly every turn from T5 to T23, finishing on 84 credits with a full untouched grip. It made only three single runs into ice (Akhet T8, Afshar T12, Envelopment T21) and never installed another breaker, while the Corp scored Transport Monopoly T10, Above the Law T13, Divested Trust T22 and Transport Monopoly T24 unopposed.

Strong use of Ansel 1.0 in Server 1 (trashed Carmen T1, scored Ingatan T2 and later Méliès City T12 behind it), but the early economy was starved (0-1 credits T2-T6) so the R&D ice could not be rezzed, and the Runner took Architect Deployment Test and Megaprix from R&D. A minor slip on T11: rezzing a second unique Wage Workers trashed the first.

Apart from stealing Post-Truth Dividend T3, the Runner spent most clicks removing tags and drawing while the broke Corp (0-4 credits from T6) scored Tomorrow's Headline, Witch Hunt, Stoke the Embers and Freedom of Information out of Server 1. On T15 it ran into the unbreakable Ping four times (three Debbie runs plus Concerto), and it never pressured R&D through Piranhas while the Corp was broke and its full HQ blanked Piranhas' end-the-run.

On T3 Ansel installed Méliès City Luxury Line into the iceless Server 1, overwriting a rezzed Nico Campaign, and the Corp advanced it on T4 without adding ice, so it was stolen that turn for 3 points. Project Ingatan was later stolen from HQ (T8), and from T14 to T16 the Corp clicked for credits on 18-24 credits with a full hand, never adding ice to R&D while Cat's Cradle ran it every turn.

The plan was sound: early steals of Kingmaking (T2) and Remastered Edition (T4) from the weak remote, then steady R&D pressure through Paywall. But the Runner usually made only one R&D run per turn and clicked for credits on 8-13 credits (T8, T10, T14) instead of making extra cheap runs, which dragged the win out to T19 while the Corp was idle.

A good start (seven early R&D runs and a steal of Above the Law T2) gave way to clicking for credits on T5-T7 and T10-T13, building up to 45 credits with a full grip and installing nothing. Apart from a T8 Server 3 steal (which Divested Trust returned) and one bounce off Afshar T9, the Runner never ran again, letting the Corp score Above the Law T10, Transport Monopoly T12 and Divested Trust T14 out of Server 4.

The Corp never played an economy card and stayed on 0-3 credits all game, so most of its ice stayed unrezzed and the Runner walked into HQ for Lotus Haze (T4). On T8 it installed Longevity Serum in Server 5 behind two unrezzed ice it could not afford to rez, and it was stolen at once; the Urtica Cipher traps were the only good plays.

Scoring Lotus Haze T3 was fine, but on T6 Longevity Serum went into Server 1 behind only Semak-samun, though the Runner had shown Rising Tide since T1 and had 13 credits, and it was stolen. Afterwards the Corp clicked for credits on 11-15 credits (T7, T9-T11) with a full hand instead of building servers, and the flatline win came mostly from the Runner's own Finality run into Saisentan.

R&D had no ice until T7 despite 10-12 credits, and the broke Runner stole two Tomorrow's Headlines (T2) and Embedded Reporting (T6) through repeated free R&D runs; Vladisibirsk City Grid in R&D's root (T4) was no substitute for ice. Oppo Research for 7 credits (T3) gave 4 tags that were never punished, and the Corp nearly lost before Next Big Thing closed out the win.

Banner was used well to punch through Akhet into HQ for Divested Trust (T2), Above the Law (T6) and SDS Drone Deployment (T15), but the Runner stayed on 0-4 credits all game, mostly clicking for single credits. It could not contest Transport Monopoly (T9) or Divested Trust (T11) in Server 1, and the T8 run into unrezzed Afshar on 4 credits only cost it 2 credits.

The Corp clicked for credits on T2-T5 while discarding from a full HQ, never installed an agenda all game, and lost Tomorrow's Headline from HQ (T6). It then spent whole turns (T7, T10, T11, T12) paying 2 credits a click to trash Stoneship Chart Room repeatedly, which drove it to 0 credits while the Runner took R&D agendas through the Grubbers.

Strong early R&D and HQ pressure, including stealing Longevity Serum from HQ on T3. Later the Runner wasted runs re-accessing the same cards: four HQ runs into a 1-card HQ that held only Saisentan on T5, and repeated Hansei Review and Hedge Fund accesses on T9-T10. Meanwhile the Server 1 cards behind the known Diviner were left alone, letting the broke Corp score Yagi-Uda T6 and the winning Yagi-Uda T14 after it sat there from T10.

Checking remotes and stealing Fujii Asset Retrieval (T7) was reasonable. But on T8, holding 1 card in grip, the Runner opened by running a freshly installed card in Server 5 against a Corp that had already shown two Urtica Ciphers and Mavirus, hit Urtica Cipher and was flatlined; it should have drawn up first or not run.

The Corp held Petty Cash and Sprint for most of the game while stuck on 0-5 credits, so Ansel 1.0 on HQ stayed unrezzed and Megaprix was stolen from a 7-8 card HQ on T7. R&D was protected only by Vertigo, which Cat's Cradle broke for 1, yet on T14-T16 the Corp clicked for credits with 7-15 credits and 8 cards instead of adding ice, losing three Project Ingatans from R&D on T13-T16.

Good aggression, trading Buzzsaw for SDS Drone Deployment from HQ (T2), Banner and Ballista for Above the Law (T6), and Boi-tatá for the winning SDS Drone T13. Minor issues: a T3 facecheck into Envelopment on 3 credits, and leaving the Privileged Access tag on T9, which let the Corp trash Fencer Fueno T10.

With no economy cards the Corp sat on 0-5 credits all game and never rezzed its HQ or R&D ice, so the Runner passed them freely, stealing from R&D (T4) and finally Project Yagi-Uda from HQ (T12). On T7 it installed Sericulture Expansion in Server 2 behind only Phoneutria, which the Runner had just run through, and it was stolen at once; the Urtica Cipher traps worked.

A solid asset economy (Nico, Otto, Tranquility, Wage Workers) with a fast double-Seamless Launch score of Méliès City T10 and a clean close behind Hagen (Ingatan T12, Megaprix T13, ADT T14). The weak spots were an econ-less T1, HQ guarded only by Drafter (Superconducting Hub stolen T6), and rezzing a second unique Wage Workers on T11, which trashed the first.

The Runner clicked for credits almost every turn from T4 to T15, building up to 43 credits with a full grip and never installing a breaker. It ran Server 3 only once (T7, bounced off Capacitor), so the Corp scored Artificial Cryptocrash T8, Next Big Thing T11 and the winning Artificial Cryptocrash T19 from it, the last after sitting installed from T12.
